text:
maria: Quick sync — I'm pulling together telemetry requirements for tuning continuous batching heuristics (batch formation, queue policies, token budgets). Need a minimal dashboard + alert set that covers kernel selection signals, KV cache behavior, and token/sec throughput. Thinking metrics: batch_util_pct, avg_batch_size, avg_queue_depth, tokens_per_sec, batch_wait_ms (p50/p95), kv_cache_hit_rate, kernel_choice_ratio (f32|int8|fallback), per-model token_budget_consumption, and request_latency_by_batch_size. Any must-haves I missed?

cheng: +1. Add waiting_time_distribution (histogram) and kv_eviction_count. Also track kernel_mismatch_rate — i.e., requests that had to fallback to a slower kernel because of shape/seq len/quantization mismatch. Alert rules idea: kv_cache_hit_rate < 0.85 for >5m, or tokens_per_sec drops >30% vs 1h baseline.

kai: For dashboard layout: time-series rows for overall health, then per-model panels. Panels I want:
- Line: batch_util_pct (1m,5m)
- Heatmap: queue_depth vs tokens_per_sec (to spot backpressure)
- Stacked bar: kernel_choice_ratio by model (shows fallback spikes)
- Histogram: batch_wait_ms p50/p95/p99
- Table: top models by token_budget_overshoot (last 24h)

Example PromQL snippets to use as panel queries:
```
# 5m avg batch utilization
avg_over_time(batch_util_pct[5m])

# tokens/sec per node
sum(rate(tokens_generated_total[1m])) by (node)

# kv cache hit rate (cluster-wide)
sum(kv_cache_hits_total) / sum(kv_cache_requests_total)
```

kai: also recommend percentiles for `batch_wait_ms` and `request_processing_ms`. p95 spikes matter more than avg.

dana: We should ensure labels on all metrics: model, quantization, route, host, and redacted customer_id (for per-tenant dashboards). Also emit `batch_formation_mode` (dynamic|fixed|on_demand) so we can correlate policy changes to util/latency. Add canary vs prod comparison panels.

perf-bot: Perf smoke run 2026-02-14 04:12 UTC summary: main-serving p95 batch_wait_ms increased 120ms -> 260ms after queue-policy change. Kernel fallback count +2.3x, kv_cache_hit_rate steady at 0.91. Top offender models: gpt-small-8k (quant mismatch on hot paths). Flame link: https://ci.redwood/internal/flames/20260214/abcd1234

maria: good signals. Next steps: I'll scaffold dashboard in Grafana under /dashboards/eng-runtime/batching and open an alerts PR for the kv/hit and tokens/sec regressions. Meeting tomorrow 10:00 to align on thresholds and per-model panels. @kai can you sketch panel layout? @cheng can you draft alert expressions? :thumbsup:
